$comment: How a test project is split across CI jobs (#2054); read by .github/scripts/test-shard-filter.ps1. Each project's 'shards' lists the class-name prefixes of every shard but the last; the last shard is everything the others did not take, so a new class always runs somewhere. A prefix matches by contains on FullyQualifiedName, and a shard leaves out what an earlier shard took, so the shards never overlap. The workflow's matrix states the shard count beside this file, and the script refuses a count that disagrees with it. Balanced on the per-class times of a green ubuntu-latest run; rebalance from the Windows vs Linux table on the PR that changes it.
